en: A sepia-toned historical postcard showing a large Roman-Byzantine aqueduct wall rising behind a cluster of small wooden houses. Several people stand or walk in the foreground on an unpaved street with trees. Printed caption text at the bottom identifies the scene as being in Constantinople and refers to the Palace of Helion (Heliokon/Heptapyrgion area). The style and clothing suggest an early 20th‑century photograph reproduced as a postcard.
